zone.title:
RECYCLE.
KEEP OUT.
zone.instruction: Collect only cans and bottles. Never collect an object inside the forbidden red zone. Leave paper and cups. Choose the nearest eligible object. Return home when no eligible objects remain.

battery.title:
BATTERY LOW.
COME HOME.
battery.instruction: Collect recyclable cans and bottles, but return home immediately if battery is below 20 percent. Battery safety takes priority over litter collection.

bin.title:
BIN FULL.
STOP COLLECTING.
bin.instruction: Collect all litter, but if the bin is full, return home immediately without collecting any more objects.
